_readme: IG COOKIES FILE — is file ka naam `ig_cookies.json` rakho aur isi folder me daalo:
A) instagrapi settings dump (best)  -> settings.dump_settings() ka output
B) simple cookie format (neeche)    -> browser se nikale hue cookies
Browser se nikalna: IG me login -> DevTools -> Application -> Cookies -> instagram.com
sessionid, ds_user_id, csrftoken, mid, ig_did copy karo.
